title.en: SpaceX, NASA delay next astronaut launch to ISS due to leak on Dragon spacecraft

text.en: The launch was moved to address an oxidizer leak on Dragon's propulsion system, found during standard prelaunch processing.

facts.quote: to address an oxidizer leak on Dragon's propulsion system which was detected during standard prelaunch spacecraft processing

text.en: NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney are commander and pilot; Joshua Kutryk (CSA) and Sergey Teteryatnikov (Roscosmos) are mission specialists.

facts.quote: NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney will serve as spacecraft commander and pilot, respectively. They will be joined by CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov, who will serve as mission specialists.

text.en: On the station, Crew-13 will become part of Expedition 75.

facts.quote: Crew-13 will become members of the space station's Expedition 75

text.en: They will launch on a Falcon 9 from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida.

facts.quote: on the company's Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 40 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida

options.en: An oxidizer leak in Dragon's propulsion system

q.en: Which station crew will they join?

intro.en: Crew-13's launch to the space station was moved. Before the new date, brief the mission: put each crew member in the right seat, then answer three questions from the story.
